s: What was India's rank in the World Happiness Report 2026?
x: India rose to 116th of 147 from 118th; Finland topped for the 9th year.

s: What was India's rank in the Press Freedom Index 2026?
x: India fell from 151st (2025) to 157th of 180 in 2026.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Sustainable Development Report 2026:
1. India ranked 94th of 169.
2. India entered the top 100 for the first time in this edition.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statement 1 is correct: 94th is India's best ever. Statement 2 is wrong: India first entered the top 100 in 2025 (99th).

s: Which country was ranked last in the Press Freedom Index 2026?
x: Eritrea was last in the Press Freedom Index 2026; Norway topped it.

s: Which organisation publishes the Press Freedom Index?
o: Institute for Economics and Peace, Sydney
x: RSF, Paris, publishes the Press Freedom Index; IEP publishes the Global Peace Index.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Global Peace Index 2026:
1. India ranked 127th of 163.
2. Bhutan was the best-ranked country in South Asia.
3. Pakistan ranked above India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Pakistan was 152nd, below India (127th).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's rank movement in 2026?
o: It fell from 151st to 157th in the Press Freedom Index
It fell from 115th to 127th in the Global Peace Index
It fell from 116th to 118th in the World Happiness Report
It stayed at 131st in the Global Gender Gap Index
x: In the World Happiness Report India rose from 118th to 116th; it did not fall.

s: What was India's rank in the Global Innovation Index 2026?
x: India ranked 38th with a score of 40.1 (49th in inputs, 25th in outputs); China ranked 10th.

s: Which cluster was ranked the top innovation cluster globally in the Global Innovation Index 2026?
x: Shenzhen–Hong Kong–Guangzhou was the top innovation cluster in the world. Bengaluru was identified as the top cluster in India, making it the most tempting alternative.

s: Which economy ranked first in the Global Innovation Index 2026 with a score of 66.7?
x: Switzerland ranked first in the GII 2026 with a score of 66.7.

s: How many pillars did the Global Innovation Index 2026 have?
x: The GII 2026 had seven pillars, and Creative Outputs was one of them.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Travel and Tourism Development Index?
o: It was produced by the WEF with Zurich Insurance Group and covered 110 economies
India ranked 41st, improving by nine places
Low travel cost and cultural resources contributed to India's performance
Japan, the US, Spain, Australia and France were the top five
x: India ranked 31st, not 41st, improving by nine places. The index was produced by the WEF with Zurich Insurance Group, covered 110 economies, and low travel cost and cultural resources helped India.

s: In the Global Cities Index 2026, which Indian city was ranked highest, at rank 268?
x: Delhi was the highest-ranked Indian city in the Global Cities Index 2026, securing rank 268. Bengaluru, Mumbai and Chennai were ranked 311, 330 and 381 respectively.

s: What was India's rank among 41 markets in the Global Business Climate Survey 2026?
x: India ranked first among 41 markets and stayed in the Top 3 for the fourth straight year.

s: Which group of countries was listed among the Top 10 for World Heritage cultural sites in the Travel and Tourism Development Index context?
x: China, India and Mexico were identified as being among the Top 10 for World Heritage cultural sites. The other combinations replace one or more of these countries with countries not included in this fact.

s: The Global Cities Index 2026 by Oxford Economics assessed cities across how many dimensions?
x: The Global Cities Index 2026 assessed cities across five dimensions: Economics, Human Capital, Quality of Life, Environment and Governance. The tempting alternatives incorrectly change the number of dimensions.

s: Where is the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) headquartered?
x: IFSCA is headquartered at GIFT City; it was established in 2020 under the IFSCA Act, 2019.

s: Which of the following was NOT identified as a challenge in the Global Business Climate Survey 2026?
x: The reported challenges were administrative complexity, regulatory unpredictability and trade barriers; tax barriers were not among them.

s: Which institution is India's nodal body for improving its rank in the Global Innovation Index?
x: NITI Aayog is India's nodal body for improving the country's ranking in the Global Innovation Index.

s: Which edition was the Global Innovation Index 2026 published by WIPO?
x: GII 2026 was WIPO's 19th edition, themed “Powering Entrepreneurs at the Frontier of Science”.

s: In the Global Financial Centres Index 40, GIFT City was the only Indian centre in the Asia-Pacific Top how many?
x: GIFT City, ranked 37th, was the only Indian centre in the Asia-Pacific Top 15, not Top 10.

s: GIFT City, located in Gandhinagar, is India's first what?
x: GIFT City in Gandhinagar is India's first operational International Financial Services Centre. It is not itself a regulatory authority, ranking centre or survey centre.

s: What was India's rank in the Network Readiness Index 2025?
x: India was 45th of 127 in NRI 2025, up from 49th of 133 in 2024.

s: Which organisation publishes the Network Readiness Index?
x: The NRI is by the Portulans Institute; the USA topped NRI 2025.

s: As per the WIPO report 2023, what is India's rank in IP/patent filings?
x: India ranked 6th in IP/patent filings in the WIPO report 2023.

s: From which rank in 2015 did India's Global Innovation Index rank improve to 38th in 2026?
The Global Innovation Index 2026 ranked how many economies?
x: GII 2026, the 19th edition, covered 139 economies with 79 indicators; India was 38th.

s: What was the rank of GIFT City in the Global Financial Centres Index 40 (September 2026)?
x: GIFT City rose 9 places to 37th; Mumbai was 49th. GFCI is by Z/Yen Partners and the China Development Institute.

s: Who publishes the Global Financial Centres Index?
o: Z/Yen Partners and China Development Institute
x: GFCI is published by Z/Yen Partners (London) with the China Development Institute; GIFT City was 37th in GFCI-40.

s: Which organisation conducts the Global Business Climate Survey, in which India was 1st of 41 markets in 2026?
x: The survey of Swedish companies abroad is done by Business Sweden, Stockholm.

s: Which city topped the Global Cities Index 2026 of Oxford Economics?
x: New York was 1st, followed by London and Paris; Delhi was the top Indian city at 268.

s: Which Indian city was the top innovation cluster of India in the Global Innovation Index 2026?
x: GII 2026 named Bengaluru India's top cluster; Shenzhen–Hong Kong–Guangzhou was the top cluster in the world.

s: In which year was the Global Innovation Index first published?
x: The GII of WIPO was first published in 2007; the 2026 edition is its 19th.

s: In the Global Innovation Index 2026, in which of the following did India rank 1st globally?
x: GII 2026 placed India 1st in the world in ICT services exports and 1st among lower-middle-income economies.

s: Under which Act was the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) set up in 2020?
x: IFSCA was set up in 2020 under the IFSCA Act, 2019, as the unified regulator, with HQ at GIFT City.

s: In the Global Innovation Index 2026, in which area did India rank 1st globally?
x: GII 2026 ranked India 1st globally in ICT services exports; India was also 1st in Central & Southern Asia and among lower-middle-income economies.

s: Which country topped the Global Gender Gap Index 2026 for the 17th straight year?
x: Iceland ranked first for the 17th straight year with 93.0% parity in the WEF's 20th edition covering 145 economies.

s: As per the Global Gender Gap Index 2026, the world (69.2% gap closed) needs about how long to reach full parity?
x: The world had closed 69.2% of the gender gap, and full parity was estimated to be about 120 years away.

s: Which one of the following correctly gives the top three countries in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026?
x: Iceland, Finland and Norway were the top three countries in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026; Chad was last.

s: Which was India's best-performing dimension in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026?
x: India scored 96.6% in Educational Attainment, above Health and Survival (95.6%), Economic Participation (41.2%) and Political Empowerment (24.5%).

s:
Assertion (A): The World Economic Forum was founded in 1971.
Reason (R): Alois Zwinggi was the founder of the World Economic Forum.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: The Assertion is true because the World Economic Forum was founded in 1971. The Reason is false: Klaus Schwab was the founder, while Alois Zwinggi was its President and CEO.

s: Which report was released by WHO and UNICEF on WASH services in schools?
o: Progress on Drinking Water, Sanitation and Hygiene in Schools 2015–2025
Global School Water and Health Report 2015–2025
Progress on Sanitation and Nutrition in Schools 2016–2026
World Report on Drinking Water and Hygiene in Colleges 2015–2025
x: The report is titled “Progress on Drinking Water, Sanitation and Hygiene in Schools 2015–2025.” The other titles alter the report’s subject, period or target institutions.

s: Which EAC-PM member flagged the decline in India's Total Fertility Rate?
x: Sanjeev Sanyal flagged the fall in India's TFR; the Council suggested reviewing population-control rules and ending sterilisation incentives.

s: According to the Gender Snapshot 2026, what share of seats in national parliaments did women hold in 2026?
x: The Gender Snapshot 2026 reported that women held 27.4% of seats in national parliaments; 35.6% is their representation in local governments.

s: According to the Sample Registration System data, what was India's Total Fertility Rate, below the replacement level of 2.1?
x: India's Total Fertility Rate was 1.9, below the replacement level of 2.1. The TFR had declined from around 3.3 in the 2000s and from 2.3 to 1.9 over a decade.

s: As per the Gender Snapshot 2026, how long may achieving gender equality take?
x: The Gender Snapshot 2026 estimated that gender equality may take 171 years.

s: Which of the following statements about the state-wise Total Fertility Rate data is incorrect?
o: Andhra Pradesh had a TFR of 1.4.
x: The incorrect statement concerns Sikkim: its TFR was 1.0, not 1.3. Bihar, Delhi and Andhra Pradesh were reported with TFRs of 2.9, 1.2 and 1.4 respectively.

s: What was India's rank in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026?
x: India ranked 131st with a parity score of 64.5%, the same rank as in the previous edition.

s: Which country was ranked last in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026?
x: Chad was ranked last in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026.

s: The Global Gender Gap Index measures gaps across how many dimensions?
x: It has four dimensions: Economic, Education, Health and Political.

s: What was India's rank in UNDP's Gender Inequality Index (2022 data)?
x: India was 108th in the Gender Inequality Index; 131st is its Gender Gap rank and 130th its HDR rank.

s: Which of the following index–publisher pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
x: The Gender Inequality Index is by UNDP, not WEF; WEF publishes the Global Gender Gap Index.

s: The Gender Snapshot 2026 was released by UN Women and which other body?
x: The Gender Snapshot is a joint report of UN Women and the UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs (UN DESA).

s: How many economies were covered in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026, in which India ranked 131st?
x: The 20th edition of WEF's Global Gender Gap Index (2026) covered 145 economies; India was 131st.

s: Which country entered the top 10 of the Global Gender Gap Index for the first time in 2026?
x: Australia entered the Global Gender Gap Index top 10 for the first time in 2026; Iceland stayed 1st.

s: In which year was UN Women, which co-releases the Gender Snapshot report, established?
x: UN Women was established in 2010 and is headquartered in New York.

s: The Sample Registration System, which reported India's TFR of 1.9, is run by the Registrar General under which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
x: The SRS is run by the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, Ministry of Home Affairs.

s: According to UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report (TDR) 2017, which of the following statements is NOT correct?
o: The global economy is facing deflationary pressures
India and China at their current levels of growth, they will become ' growth poles ' for global economy in near future
Developing countries need to focus on domestic demand
Financial globalisation has not led to better allocation of capital
x: The notes cover only the UNCTAD TDR 2026 (India 7.3% growth, Asia 59% of global growth) and say nothing about the TDR 2017 statements. Option 2 is the one that is not correct, since the 2017 report did not say India and China would become 'growth poles' at current growth levels.

s: According to the Annual Survey of Industries 2024–25, which State ranked first in the number of factories?
x: Tamil Nadu ranked first with 41,221 factories. Gujarat ranked second, Maharashtra third and Andhra Pradesh sixth, so Gujarat is the closest but incorrect alternative.

s: As per MoSPI's Annual Survey of Industries 2024-25, how did the number of factories in India change?
x: The survey of organised manufacturing showed factories rising from 2.60 lakh to 2.67 lakh.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Annual Survey of Industries 2024–25?
o: Basic metals, motor vehicles, chemicals, pharma and food contributed over 45% of manufacturing GVA
Gujarat was among the top five States in employment
Tamil Nadu was among the top five States in employment
The top five employment States together accounted for 65% of employment
x: The top five States (Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh and Haryana) accounted for 56% of employment, not 65%.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UNCTAD Trade and Development Report 2026?
o: The share of strategic sectors rose from 16% to 34%
Malaysia accounted for 4% of global greenfield investment
Energy transition accounted for 7.8% of greenfield investment
India accounted for 5.7% of global greenfield investment during 2020–25
x: The strategic-sector share rose from 16% to 44%, not 34%. India's 5.7% share, Malaysia's 4% and energy transition's 7.8% are as reported.

s: In which year was UNCTAD, which publishes the Trade and Development Report, established?
x: UNCTAD was established in 1964; the first Trade and Development Report came in 1981.

s: In the World Bank Poverty and Inequality Report 2026, what was the threshold for India's poorest 10%?
x: India's poorest 10% had a threshold of USD 3 per day and the richest 10% a threshold of USD 10 per day; these were distribution thresholds, not averages.

s: In 2025, to what level was the extreme poverty line reported through the Poverty and Inequality Platform revised?
x: The extreme poverty line was revised in 2025 to USD 3.00 per day in 2021 PPP, with data provided through the Poverty and Inequality Platform.

s: What growth rate did the World Bank's Global Economic Prospects (June 2026) project for India in FY27?
x: GEP raised India's FY27 forecast to 6.6% from 6.5%; 6.3% is the OECD forecast and 7.3% UNCTAD's.

s: What is the theme of UNCTAD's World Investment Report 2026?
o: International Investment in a Turbulent Era
x: WIR 2026 is titled "International Investment in a Turbulent Era"; "The Promise of AI" is WDR 2026.

s: As per the IMF (2025), what is India's rank among the world's largest economies?
x: India slipped from 5th to 6th largest economy ($3.92 trillion) per the IMF 2025.

s: Which of the following agency–India growth forecast pairs is correctly matched?
x: The IMF's October 2026 World Economic Outlook projects India's 2026 growth at 7.0%. The OECD (June 2026) gave 6.3% for FY27, the World Bank GEP (June 2026) 6.6%, and Fitch Ratings lowered FY27 to 6.4% (7.3% is UNCTAD's 2026 figure).

s: How many Millennium Development Goals were set under the UN Millennium Declaration of 2000?
x: The Millennium Declaration (2000) gave eight MDGs with 2015 as the target year; the 17 SDGs replaced them from 2016.

s: According to UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report 2026, what share of global greenfield investment (2020–25) went to India?
x: India drew 5.7% of global greenfield investment in 2020–25 – more than twice China's 2.8%.

s: What was the reported impact of the Baramati AI application on sugarcane cultivation?
o: Sugarcane yields increased by 40%, while water and fertiliser use fell by 35%.
Sugarcane yields increased by 35%, while water and fertiliser use fell by 40%.
Sugarcane yields increased by 30%, while water and fertiliser use fell by 40%.
Sugarcane yields increased by 40%, while water and fertiliser use fell by 30%.
x: At Baramati, sugarcane yields increased by 40%, while water and fertiliser use declined by 30%. The other options interchange the reported percentages.

s: Which of the following is the correct order of the top three countries in the Global Innovation Index 2025?
o: Sweden, Switzerland, United States of America
Switzerland, Sweden, United States of America
United States of America, Switzerland, Sweden
Switzerland, United States of America, Sweden
x: Switzerland ranked first, Sweden second and the United States of America third in the Global Innovation Index 2025.

s: Which State topped the Data Centre Policy Attractiveness India Index assessed by S&P Global?
x: Telangana ranked first in the Top tier of the Data Centre Policy Attractiveness India Index. Maharashtra was also in the Top tier, whereas Odisha and Andhra Pradesh were placed in the Second tier.

s: To what level did private AI investment in India rise in 2025 from USD 1.2 billion in 2024?
x: Private AI investment in India rose to USD 4.1 billion in 2025; about 23% of firms in India used AI against about 43% in the US.

s: Who published the World Development Report 2026, titled “The Promise of AI”?
o: Union Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
x: The World Development Report 2026, “The Promise of AI,” was published by the World Bank Group. IndiaAI Mission and MeitY organised the India launch, but they were not the publisher.

s: Which framework does the World Development Report 2026 use for understanding the adoption of artificial intelligence?
x: The report uses the Adopt–Adapt–Advance framework. Capabilities, Concentration and Complements are the report’s Three Cs, not the name of the framework.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the World Development Report 2026?
o: It covers about 5.6 billion people in low- and middle-income countries
It identifies Three Cs: Capabilities, Concentration and Complements
It recommends that every low- and middle-income country build frontier AI from scratch
x: The report explicitly does not recommend building frontier AI from scratch; the other statements describe it correctly.

s: According to the World Bank report “India and Artificial Intelligence: Seizing the Development Opportunity”, how was India placed among emerging markets in AI readiness?
x: The report dated 6 October 2026 placed India among the 10 best emerging markets in AI readiness. Its identified strengths were India’s tech workforce, IT sector and digital public infrastructure.

s: According to the World Development Report 2026, how long did steam take to diffuse to lower-income economies?
x: The report gives 80 years for steam, 40 years for electricity and 20 years for the internet.

s: How many pillars does the IndiaAI Mission have?
x: The IndiaAI Mission has 7 pillars, including Compute, AIKosh datasets, FutureSkills, Startup Financing and Safe & Trusted AI.

s: Which of the following correctly represents the Digital Public Infrastructure examples cited for India in the World Bank’s AI-readiness context?
x: India’s cited DPI examples are Aadhaar, UPI and DigiLocker. IBRD, IDA and IFC are World Bank Group institutions, while the other options refer to the IndiaAI Mission and the report’s framework.

s: Which initiative in the World Development Report 2026 used AI to screen children aged 0–6 years for developmental delays?
x: Navachetana in Andhra Pradesh used AI to screen children aged 0–6 years for developmental delays. MahaVISTAAR AI, EdskGrid and Vyuhaa-Cerviai are other initiatives listed in the Indian examples.

s: In which tier was Andhra Pradesh placed in the Data Centre Policy Attractiveness India Index?
o: The third tier, with Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal
The second tier, with Odisha, Haryana and Karnataka
The first tier, as the top State
x: Andhra Pradesh was in the second tier (scores 42–45) with Odisha, Haryana and Karnataka; the third tier scored 30–40.

s: What is the theme of UNDP's Human Development Report 2025?
o: A Matter of Choice: People and Possibilities in the Age of AI
International Investment in a Turbulent Era
x: HDR 2025 is "A Matter of Choice: People and Possibilities in the Age of AI"; "The Promise of AI" is the World Bank's WDR 2026.

s: What was India's rank in Stanford's Global AI Vibrancy 2025 ranking?
x: India was 3rd in Stanford's Global AI Vibrancy 2025.

s: Which of the following are the 'Three Cs' in the World Bank's World Development Report 2026 on AI?
x: WDR 2026 frames AI around Capabilities, Concentration and Complements, within Adopt–Adapt–Advance.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of the five institutions of the World Bank Group?
x: The World Bank Group has IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA and ICSID; the IMF is a separate Bretton Woods body.

src: APPSC Forest Subordinate Service (Thanedar) Paper-II General
s: Why are roughages important in our food?
o: They help in expel of undigested food

s: According to the FAO State of the World's Forests 2026, approximately how much land globally is degraded?
x: Approximately 1.56 billion hectares of land is degraded globally, equivalent to about 10% of the world's land area. The tempting figure of 460 million hectares refers to degraded forests, not total degraded land.

s: How often does the FAO Committee on Forestry (COFO) meet?
x: COFO meets every two years; its 28th session was held with the 10th World Forest Week under the theme “Forests for Food, Resilience and Prosperity”.

s: What average decline in monitored wildlife populations between 1970 and 2022 was reported in the Living Planet Report 2026?
x: The Living Planet Report 2026 reported an average 73% decline in monitored populations between 1970 and 2022. The figures of 85%, 69% and 59% refer respectively to freshwater, terrestrial and marine categories, not the overall average.

s: The MoSPI Strategy for Environmental Economic Accounts 2026–2030 was released by which division of the NSO?
x: It was released by the Social Statistics Division of NSO under MoSPI, continuing the 2022–2026 strategy; it supports about 40 indicators of 9 SDGs.

s: What share of India's area does the National Forest Policy, 1988 envisage under forest and tree cover?
x: The National Forest Policy, 1988 envisages 33% of the area under forest and tree cover; India's actual cover is 82.74 million ha or 25.17%.

s: In the Living Planet Report 2026, which region–decline pair is correctly matched?
o: Latin America and the Caribbean – 95% decline
x: The report recorded declines of 95% in Latin America and the Caribbean, 80% in Africa and 49% in the Asia-Pacific.

s: Where was the 28th Session of the FAO Committee on Forestry held (28 September–2 October 2026)?
x: The 28th COFO session was held in Rome, where the FAO (established 1945) is headquartered.

s: Which of the following is a priority under the MoSPI Strategy for Environmental Economic Accounts 2026–2030?
x: The priorities include forests, water, land, soil, minerals, carbon stocks, biodiversity and pollination services; tourism, transport and urban housing are not listed.

s: As per the 7th GCRMN Status of Coral Reefs report, what was the annual decline in hard coral cover during 2023–24?
x: The annual decline during 2023–24 was 8.9%; 9.5% is the fall in hard coral cover against the 1980–2009 baseline.

s: What share of the world's coral reefs had experienced heat stress in 2024?
x: The reported 2024 figure was 87% of reefs with heat stress; in bleaching, corals expel symbiotic zooxanthellae and turn white.

s: According to the WMO State of Global Water Resources 2025, around what share of the world's river basins were drier than normal?
x: Around 36% of river basins were drier than normal, supporting the description of 2025 as one of the driest years in 35 years.

s: According to the UNEP–CCAC report, how many premature deaths did air pollution cause in 2025?
x: The report estimated 8.4 million premature deaths in 2025, and said 25 measures across six sectors could prevent 144 million deaths by 2050.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the findings of the “Forests for Food” report?
o: In 2022, 1.8 billion people (23%) depended on wood fuel for cooking
410 million people depended on wood fuel to boil water
Pollinators account for 35% of crop production
More than 2 billion people use forest medicinal plants
x: The report put users of forest medicinal plants at over 1 billion, not more than 2 billion. The other three figures are as reported.

s: Who is the Director-General of the Rome-headquartered FAO, associated with the 'Forests for Food' report?
x: The FAO is headquartered in Rome and its Director-General is Qu Dongyu.

s: According to the FAO–Landscape Alliance report 'Forests for Food', how many people depend on forests?
x: Over 5 billion people depend on forests; forests give up to 20% of rural income and wild foods up to 80% of daily protein in remote communities.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network – Established in 1995 under the International Coral Reef Initiative
x: The GCRMN was established in 1995 under the International Coral Reef Initiative; Lakshadweep has atolls and the Andaman and Nicobar reefs are fringing reefs.

s: According to the WMO State of Global Water Resources 2025, groundwater depletion continued during 2022–25 particularly in which part of India?
x: The report highlighted continued groundwater depletion in north-western India during 2022–25. The other regions are not identified in this finding.

s: In which year was the Climate and Clean Air Coalition established?
x: The Climate and Clean Air Coalition was established in 2012 and addresses short-lived pollutants such as methane, black carbon and HFCs.

s: The FAO and Landscape Alliance report “Forests for Food” examined the contribution of forests to which four dimensions of food security?
x: The report linked forests with four dimensions of food security: availability, access, utilisation and stability. The other options introduce terms that are not identified as the report’s four dimensions.

s: Which technologies were highlighted as key in the IEA Special Report on Electrification 2026?
x: The report highlighted transport, buildings and industry, with electric vehicles and heat pumps as the key technologies.

s: Where is the International Energy Agency headquartered?
x: The IEA dates from 1974 and is based in Paris, not Geneva.

s: According to the 2024 study on countries' contributions to global warming, what was India's estimated contribution?
x: The study estimated India's contribution at about 0.05°C, rising since 1990 due to fossil-fuel use, agricultural methane and nitrous oxide.

s: According to the 2024 study on contributions to global warming, which country's contribution was estimated at 0.27°C?
x: The study put the USA's contribution at 0.27°C, China's at 0.19°C, Russia's at 0.07–0.08°C and India's at about 0.05°C.

s: In the Climate Risk Index 2026 (Germanwatch), what was India's rank among the most affected countries (1995–2024)?
x: India was 9th most affected; Dominica was 1st.

s: In the World Air Quality Report 2025, how many of the top 10 most polluted cities were Indian?
x: Five of the top 10 most polluted cities were Indian; Loni was the worst city.

s: Which institution publishes the Air Quality Life Index (AQLI) 2025?
x: AQLI is by EPIC, Chicago; IQAir publishes the World Air Quality Report and HEI–IHME the State of Global Air.

s: What weight does Ecosystem Vitality carry in the Environmental Performance Index 2026?
x: EPI 2026 weights: Ecosystem Vitality 45%, Climate Mitigation 30%, Environmental Health 25%.

s: What weight do GHG emissions carry in the Climate Change Performance Index?
x: CCPI weights: GHG 40%, renewables 20%, energy use 20%, climate policy 20%.

s: Which organisation publishes the World Disasters Report?
o: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
x: The World Disasters Report is the annual report of the IFRC on disasters and their human impact.

s: According to the Living Planet Report 2026, which category of wildlife populations showed the steepest decline?
x: Freshwater populations fell 85%, the steepest, against a 73% average decline (1970–2022).

s: Which organisations release the Living Planet Report?
x: The Living Planet Report is released by WWF with the Zoological Society of London (ZSL).

s: How many targets does the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (CBD COP15, 2022) have?
x: The KMGBF, adopted at CBD COP15 in 2022, has 23 targets.

s: What share of India's geographical area was under forest and tree cover, as cited at COFO 28 (2026)?
x: India reported forest and tree cover of 82.74 million ha, i.e. 25.17% of its area; the 1988 policy goal is 33%.

s: Who is the Executive Director of the International Energy Agency?
x: Fatih Birol heads the IEA, set up in 1974 in Paris within the OECD framework.

s: Coral bleaching occurs when corals expel which symbiotic organisms?
x: In bleaching, corals expel the symbiotic zooxanthellae algae and turn white; they can recover if conditions improve.

s: Which organisations publish the Living Planet Report?
o: WWF and the Zoological Society of London
x: The Living Planet Report is published by WWF with the Zoological Society of London (ZSL); WWF was set up in 1961 and is based in Gland.

s: How many global targets for 2030 does the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (2022) contain?
x: The KMGBF, adopted at CBD COP15 in 2022, has 23 targets for 2030.

s: Which publication on environment statistics is brought out by MoSPI in line with the UN SEEA framework?
x: MoSPI publishes EnviStats India; its environmental accounts follow the UN System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA).

s: The Sustainable Development Goals, to be achieved by 2030, comprise how many goals?
x: The SDGs comprise 17 goals and 169 targets, to be achieved by 2030.

s: According to The Lancet Public Health study, India's second-hand smoke deaths rose from 2,17,700 in 1990 to what number in 2023?
x: India recorded 3,25,600 second-hand smoke deaths in 2023, up from 2,17,700 in 1990.

s: According to the Lancet findings, India's population exposed to second-hand smoke rose from 375 million to what number?
x: India's exposed population rose from 375 million to 444 million, an increase of 18.4%; 767 million was the global number of exposed children.

s: In which year did the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control come into force?
x: The WHO FCTC was adopted in 2003 and came into force in 2005.

s: Which section of COTPA, 2003 bans smoking in public places?
x: Section 4 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 bans smoking in public places.

s: In which year did India ratify the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control?
x: The WHO FCTC was adopted in 2003 and came into force in 2005; India ratified it in 2004.

s: Which district topped the NITI Aayog Aspirational Districts Delta Rankings for April–June 2026?
x: Gadchiroli in Maharashtra ranked first in the April–June 2026 rankings, while Baramulla ranked second. Purnia had topped the previous quarter, January–March 2026, and Chitrakoot had ranked second in that quarter.

s: In the NITI Aayog Aspirational Districts framework, what weight does the Agriculture and Water theme carry?
x: Agriculture and Water carries 20%; Health and Nutrition and Education carry 30% each, while Financial Inclusion and Skills and Basic Infrastructure carry 10% each.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: The Aspirational Districts Programme was launched in January 2018 and covers 112 districts; the Blocks Programme began in January 2023 and NITI Aayog on 1 January 2015.

s: Which district ranked first among Andhra Pradesh's 26 districts in the YouthPOWER rankings, with a score of 55?
x: Visakhapatnam ranked first among AP's 26 districts in the YouthPOWER rankings of the AP State Handbook of Youth Opportunity, with a score of 55.

s: Which State or Union Territory retained the first position in the India Electric Mobility Index 2025 released by NITI Aayog with World Resources Institute India?
x: Delhi retained first place in the India Electric Mobility Index 2025, improving its score from 77 to 84. Maharashtra and Karnataka ranked second and third, while Andhra Pradesh ranked ninth.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank in the India Electric Mobility Index 2025?
x: Andhra Pradesh ranked ninth with 52 points, while Telangana ranked tenth with 51 points.

s: Which State topped the third edition of Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari and Catch the Rain?
x: Chhattisgarh was adjudged the best State under Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari and Catch the Rain, third edition. West Bengal, Telangana and Nagaland are not identified as the top State in this finding.

s: When was Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari launched?
x: Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari was launched in September 2024 to promote rainwater harvesting, recharge and revival of defunct borewells.

s: The Ministry of Jal Shakti was formed in 2019 by merging the Ministry of Water Resources with which ministry?
o: Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
x: The Jal Shakti Ministry was formed in 2019 by merging the Water Resources and Drinking Water and Sanitation ministries.

s: Which States led the Large States category of the India Electric Mobility Index 2025?
x: Large States were led by Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu; Manipur, Tripura and Assam led Hilly and NE States, and Delhi, Chandigarh and Goa the UTs/City States.

s: According to the CEA peak power demand rankings for August 2026, which State stood at the fifth position?
x: Telangana ranked fifth with a peak demand of 17,263 MW in August 2026. Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Gujarat occupied the first, second and third positions respectively, so they are not the correct answer.

s: The YouthPOWER rankings in the AP State Handbook of Youth Opportunity used about how many indicators?
x: The assessment used about 180 indicators drawn from 27 databases across five parameters.

s: According to the YouthPOWER findings, which State recorded the fastest growth in young women's banking and digital access?
x: Andhra Pradesh recorded the fastest growth in young women's banking and digital access among all States surveyed.

s: Which State topped the India Justice Report 2025?
x: Karnataka topped IJR 2025 with 6.78; Andhra Pradesh was 2nd with 6.32.

s: What was Guntur's joint rank in Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026 (3-10 lakh category)?
x: Guntur (AP) was joint 2nd in the 3–10 lakh category of Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026; Rourkela topped that category.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank in NITI Aayog's Investment Friendliness Index 2026?
x: Andhra Pradesh was 8th (score 48.7) in NITI Aayog's first Investment Friendliness Index 2026; Gujarat was 1st (56.6) and Telangana 13th.

s: In PGI 2.0 (2025-26), which became the first to reach the Uttam-3 grade?
x: No State/UT reached Utkarsh; Chandigarh was the first Uttam-3.

s: Which of the following survey–top city pairs is correctly matched?
x: Indore topped the Super Swachh League of Swachh Survekshan for the 8th time; Swachh Vayu 2026 was led by Lucknow and Rourkela, and NARI named Kohima and Visakhapatnam.

s:
Consider the following statements about the India Justice Report:
1. AP ranked 2nd in the India Justice Report 2025.
2. AP ranked 1st of 19 States in IJR Consumer Justice 2026.
3. Telangana ranked 1st in the India Justice Report 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: AP was 2nd in IJR 2025 (up from 5th in 2022) and 1st of 19 States in the Consumer Justice Report 2026. Statement 3 is wrong: Karnataka topped IJR 2025; Telangana was 3rd.

s: Which city topped Category 1 (above 10 lakh) of Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026?
x: Lucknow rose from 15th to 1st; Indore was 2nd and Jabalpur 3rd, while Delhi was 30th.

s: Which States were the top States for employability in the India Skills Report 2026?
x: ISR 2026 (ETS with CII, AICTE and AIU) named Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka at the top; employability was 56.35%.

s: Who prepares the India Skills Report 2026?
o: ETS with CII, AICTE and AIU
x: The India Skills Report 2026 is by ETS with CII, AICTE and AIU; UP, Maharashtra and Karnataka were the top States.

s: Which city won the State-level Swachh City award at the Swachh Andhra Awards 2026?
x: Vijayawada Municipal Corporation won the Swachh City award and a Swachh Vayu award on 2 October 2026.

s: How many districts are covered under NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme, launched in January 2018?
x: The ADP covers 112 districts and works on the 3Cs – Convergence, Collaboration, Competition.

s: In the India Electric Mobility Index 2025, which category carries the highest weight (50%)?
x: Transport Electrification Progress has 50%, Charging Infrastructure Readiness 30% and EV Research and Innovation 20%.

s: Which State had the highest peak power demand in August 2026, as per the CEA?
x: Uttar Pradesh was 1st with 31,296 MW, then Maharashtra and Gujarat; Andhra Pradesh was 9th.

s: Which city topped Category 2 (3–10 lakh population) of Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026?
x: Rourkela (Odisha) topped Category 2 and Kalinganagar topped Category 3; Lucknow topped Category 1.

s: Under the revised NCAP target, by how much should particulate matter be cut by 2026 (base 2017)?
x: NCAP (2019) first aimed at a 20–30% cut by 2024; the target was revised to 40% by 2026. Progress is tracked on PRANA.

s: Which State ranked last in the Consumer Justice Report 2026 of the India Justice Report, in which Andhra Pradesh was 1st?
x: Andhra Pradesh topped (6.28/10) among 19 States, while Telangana was last (2.20).

s: In which year was the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) launched by the MoEFCC?
x: NCAP was launched by the MoEFCC in 2019; 2017 is its base year for measuring cuts in particulate matter.

s: What is the revised NCAP target for cutting particulate matter levels by 2026 (base year 2017)?
x: NCAP first aimed at a 20-30% cut by 2024; the target was revised to a 40% cut by 2026. Progress is tracked on the PRANA portal.

s: On which portal is the progress of cities under the National Clean Air Programme tracked?
x: Progress of the 130 NCAP cities is tracked on the PRANA portal.

s: What are the '3Cs' of the Aspirational Districts Programme?
x: The ADP, launched in January 2018 for 112 districts, rests on Convergence, Collaboration and Competition.

s: International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies, marked in India as Swachh Vayu Diwas, falls on which date?
x: 7 September is the International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies; the 5th Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan Awards were given on this day.

s: Who headed the Supreme Court-appointed National Task Force on student mental health in higher educational institutions?
x: The National Task Force was headed by former Supreme Court judge Justice S. Ravindra Bhat. Alok Sarin, Mary E. John and Rajendra Kachroo were among its members, not its head.

s: On which date did MoSPI become an independent ministry?
x: MoSPI became an independent ministry on 15 October 1999. NSO under MoSPI recently signed an MoU on official statistics with the Pahle India Foundation.

s: In the Lokniti-CSDS and Common Cause study on scams, which category accounted for 33% of cases?
x: Fake delivery calls made up 33% of the scams, investment scams 31% and bank impersonation 27%. Sexual harassment (4%) was a type of cyber-crime faced by victims, not a scam category.

s: India's first National Household Travel Survey, covering the period July 2025–June 2026, was conducted by which organisation?
x: India's first National Household Travel Survey was conducted by the National Statistical Office under MoSPI during July 2025–June 2026. The Central Electricity Authority and Pahle India Foundation were not the conducting organisation for this survey.

s: Which bodies were merged in 2019 to form the National Statistical Office?
o: CSO and Registrar General of India
x: The NSO was formed in 2019 by merging the Central Statistics Office and the National Sample Survey Office.

s: How many cybercrime cases did the NCRB report for India in 2024?
x: The NCRB reported 1,01,928 cybercrime cases in 2024, up from 86,420 in 2023.

s: According to the ADR and National Election Watch findings for 2022–2026, which State recorded the highest number of sitting legislators changing parties?
x: Nagaland recorded the highest number, with 32 sitting legislators changing parties. West Bengal recorded 20 and Telangana 9, so neither is the correct answer.

s: The Tenth Schedule (anti-defection law) was added to the Constitution by which Amendment in 1985?
x: The Tenth Schedule was introduced by the 52nd Constitutional Amendment in 1985.

s: The Supreme Court-appointed National Task Force survey on student mental health covered how many students?
x: The survey covered 2.43 lakh students, not 2.34 lakh; 15% faced severe stress or anxiety.

s: As per ADR and National Election Watch, how many sitting legislators in 17 States/UTs changed parties in 2022–2026?
x: 111 sitting legislators changed parties: 26 Lok Sabha MPs, 7 Rajya Sabha MPs and 78 MLAs.

s: As per NCRB Crime in India 2024, which State recorded the highest number of cybercrime cases?
x: Telangana had the most cybercrime cases (27,230); Bengaluru was the top metro.

s: Where is the World Justice Project, which publishes the Rule of Law Index, based?
x: WJP was established in 2006 and is based in Washington DC.

s: The WJP Rule of Law Index assesses countries on how many factors?
x: The Rule of Law Index uses 8 factors on a 0–1 scale.

s: Which Andhra Pradesh city was among the safest cities in NARI 2025?
x: NARI 2025 (not an NCRB report) named Kohima and Visakhapatnam the safest.

s: National Statistics Day, observed on 29 June, marks the birth anniversary of whom?
x: 29 June is the birth anniversary of P.C. Mahalanobis, founder of ISI Kolkata (1931).

s: Which Indian institution ranked highest in the QS World University Rankings 2027?
x: IIT Delhi (118th) was the top Indian institution; MIT was 1st for the 15th year.

s: In the THE Asia University Rankings 2026, which was the only Indian institution in the top 50?
x: IISc was 43rd, the only Indian institution in the top 50; Tsinghua was 1st.

s: Which institution topped the NIRF 2025 rankings for the 7th year?
x: IIT Madras topped NIRF 2025 for the 7th year.

s: In NIRF, what weight does the Teaching-Learning parameter carry?
x: NIRF weights: Teaching-Learning 30%, Research 30%, Graduation Outcomes 20%, Outreach 10%, Perception 10%.

s: Which was India's top-ranked institution in the THE World University Rankings 2027?
x: IISc Bengaluru was India's best at 254th; no Indian university made the global top 200.

s: Which university topped the THE World University Rankings 2027 for the 11th straight year?
x: Oxford was 1st for the 11th straight year in the THE World University Rankings 2027; MIT was 2nd.

s: Which option correctly identifies the founding year and headquarters of WHO and UNICEF?
x: WHO was established in 1948 with headquarters in Geneva, while UNICEF was established in 1946 with headquarters in New York. The other options interchange the organisations, years or headquarters.

s: The Global Innovation Index is released by which organisation?
x: The Global Innovation Index is released by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO).

s: Which organisation publishes the Global Gender Gap Index 2026?
x: The Global Gender Gap Index 2026 was published by the World Economic Forum.

s: What GDP growth did UNCTAD project for India in 2026, making it the fastest-growing major economy?
x: India's projected GDP growth for 2026 was 7.3%; Asia accounted for 59% of global growth.

s: The Central Electricity Authority, which operates under the Electricity Act, 2003, is associated with which ministry?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
x: The Central Electricity Authority is associated with the Ministry of Power and operates under the Electricity Act, 2003.

s: As per a UNICEF report (October 2026), about how many Indian girls and women were married before the age of 18?
x: UNICEF puts the number at about 22.24 crore; about 9.05 crore of them were married before 15.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about child marriage in India?
o: The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 sets the minimum age at 18 for women and 21 for men
Ending child marriage falls under SDG target 5.3
NFHS-5 showed a rise from NFHS-4 in women aged 20–24 married before 18
NFHS-5 recorded 23.3% of women aged 20–24 married before 18
x: NFHS-5 showed a fall, not a rise: 23.3% against 26.8% in NFHS-4.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: International Day of the Girl Child – 24 January
x: UNICEF is headquartered in New York (set up 11 December 1946). Girl Child Day is 11 October internationally and 24 January nationally.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the CEA peak power demand data for August 2026?
o: Telangana's peak demand grew about 6.5% to 17,263 MW
Telangana surpassed Tamil Nadu, Gujarat and Maharashtra
x: Telangana surpassed Punjab, Rajasthan and Karnataka; Tamil Nadu, Gujarat and Maharashtra stayed ahead of it.

s: Under which Act was the Central Electricity Authority originally set up?
x: The CEA was set up under the Electricity (Supply) Act, 1948 and now functions under the Electricity Act, 2003, under the Ministry of Power.

s: According to India's first National Household Travel Survey, which mode of transport is most used by commuting workers?
x: Two-wheelers are the most used mode, at 42.6% of commuting workers.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's first National Household Travel Survey?
o: Rural workers spent more on commuting than urban workers
It was conducted by the NSO, MoSPI, from July 2025 to June 2026
The average monthly commuting spend per worker was Rs 785
Urban workers spent about Rs 1,044 a month on commuting
x: Urban workers spent more: Rs 1,044 a month against Rs 612 in rural areas.

s: According to the NITI Aayog report on higher-education teachers, which State/UT has the highest number of female teachers per 100 male teachers?
x: Kerala has the highest ratio, 182 female teachers per 100 male teachers; the national ratio is 82, and Chhattisgarh and Himachal Pradesh are at parity (100).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about higher-education teachers as per a NITI Aayog report (October 2026)?
o: Teachers rose from 13,67,535 in 2013–14 to 17,32,294 in 2023–24
Nationally there are 87 female teachers per 100 male teachers
The female share of teachers rose from 39% to 45%
The number of teachers rose by over 3.6 lakh between 2013–14 and 2023–24
x: The national ratio is 82 female per 100 male teachers; 87 is the figure for ST teachers.

s: As per the NITI Aayog report on higher-education teachers, which States are at gender parity (100 female per 100 male teachers)?
x: Chhattisgarh and Himachal Pradesh are at parity (100 female per 100 male teachers); Kerala, at 182, is far above parity.

s: Since when has smoking in public places been banned in India?
x: Smoking in public places has been banned since 2 October 2008; about 44.4 crore Indians were exposed to second-hand smoke in 2023.

s: According to an iFOREST report (October 2026), India's green economy could create how many jobs by 2035?
x: iFOREST estimates the green economy could create 1.3 crore jobs by 2035.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the iFOREST report "India's Green Jobs Movement"?
o: Direct green jobs may rise from 14.5 lakh in 2026 to 35 lakh in 2030
About 4.5 lakh new green jobs may be created each year
In 2025 only 4.5% of the working-age population had technical education
x: iFOREST is headquartered in New Delhi, not Bengaluru.

s: Which of the following pairs related to India's green targets is correctly matched?
o: Skill Council for Green Jobs – set up in 2020
x: 500 GW non-fossil capacity is targeted by 2030. Green hydrogen of 5 MMT is also by 2030, net zero by 2070, and the Skill Council was set up in 2015.

s: The Ayush Services Sector Report 2026, released by the Ministry of Ayush, was prepared by which organisation?
o: RIS (Research and Information System for Developing Countries)
x: The report was prepared by RIS and released on Ayurveda Day 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Ayush Services Sector Report 2026?
o: Women make up 43% of the Ayush workforce
The sector was valued at USD 36.92 billion in FY2024-25
Day-care centres form the largest segment of the sector by value
Standalone clinics are valued at USD 16.21 billion
x: Standalone clinics are the largest segment at USD 16.21 billion (43.9%); day-care centres are USD 10.13 billion.

s: What is the title of UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report 2026?
x: The October 2026 report is titled "The Geoeconomics of Development".

s: What global growth for 2026 does UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report 2026 project?
x: Global growth is projected to fall from 2.9% in 2025 to 2.6% in 2026; India is projected at 7.3%.

s: Which of the following pairs about UNCTAD is correctly matched?
o: Trade and Development Report annual since – 1964
x: UNCTAD is headquartered in Geneva; it was set up in 1964, the TDR has been annual since 1981, and it publishes the World Investment Report.

s: What is India's rank in the Global Hunger Index 2026?
x: India is 100th of 122 with a score of 24.1; Pakistan is 106th.

s: India's score of 24.1 in the Global Hunger Index 2026 places it in which category?
x: A score of 24.1 is in the Serious category; Pakistan (106th, 25.5) ranks below India (100th).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Global Hunger Index?
o: It is prepared by Welthungerhilfe, IFHV and Helvetas
Scores of 20.0–34.9 are classed as serious
Under-five mortality is not one of its indicators
x: Under-five mortality is one of the four indicators, along with undernourishment, child wasting and child stunting.

s: Which country tops the Henley Passport Index 2026?
x: Singapore is 1st with visa-free access to 193 destinations; Japan, UAE and South Korea are joint 2nd.

s: With which countries does India share the 84th rank in the Henley Passport Index 2026?
x: India shares 84th with Algeria and Mauritania; its rank improved from 85th though visa-free access fell from 57 to 55.

s: The Data Centre Evaluation Framework released in October 2026 came from which body?
x: It was released by the NITI Aayog Frontier Tech Hub; MeitY, the Ministry of Power and DPIIT gave inputs.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NITI Aayog Data Centre Evaluation Framework?
o: It covers five areas, including water and cooling
India's data-centre capacity grew from about 375 MW (2020) to 1.5 GW (2026)
The NITI Aayog Frontier Tech Hub was set up in March 2025
It covers four areas, excluding policy and governance
x: The framework covers five areas: power and energy, water and cooling, environment, economic value, and policy and governance.

s: According to the UNESCO Global Report on Teachers, India is short of about how many teachers?
x: The report says India is short of over 11 lakh teachers, from primary to Class 12.

s: According to the UNESCO Global Report on Teachers (October 2026), how many more teachers are needed globally by 2030?
x: Globally, 5 crore more teachers are needed by 2030; India has about one lakh single-teacher schools.

s: Which Indian city was named in National Geographic's "Best of the World 2027" list released on 20 October 2026?
x: Jaipur was chosen for its heritage and its 300th foundation anniversary in 2027.

s: Who founded Jaipur, named in National Geographic's "Best of the World 2027", in 1727?
x: Jaipur was founded in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II and became a UNESCO site in 2019.

s: What is India's rank in the Quality of Care Perception Index of the Ipsos Health Service Report 2026?
x: India is 3rd among 32 countries, after Malaysia and Singapore.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India in the Ipsos Health Service Report 2026?
o: 68% of Indians were positive about healthcare quality
India ranked 1st in ease of doctor appointments
Mental health was the top health worry of Indians
x: Diabetes (40%) was the top health worry; mental health (37%) was second.

s: According to the ASI Annual Report 2025-26, what was Golconda Fort's rank among the most visited centrally protected ticketed monuments by domestic tourists?
x: Golconda Fort ranked 7th with 16,76,102 domestic visitors.

s: What is India's rank in the WJP Rule of Law Index 2026?
x: India is 88th of 143 with a score of 0.48, down from 86th in 2025.

s: Which country is ranked last (143rd) in the WJP Rule of Law Index 2026?
x: Venezuela is last at 143rd (0.26); Afghanistan is 142nd and Denmark tops the index.

s: Which Indian museum was ranked 9th in the World's 100 Best Museums 2026?
x: Bihar Museum, Patna, was ranked 9th globally and 1st in Asia.

s: Which organisation publishes the World's 100 Best Museums 2026 ranking?
x: The ranking is by Worth a Journey, a Germany-based travel guide; the Metropolitan Museum of Art is 10th and the Louvre 31st.

s: According to the World Bank Poverty and Equity Brief, India's extreme poverty fell to what level in 2023?
x: Extreme poverty fell from 27.1% in 2011 to 2.6% in 2023.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the World Bank Poverty and Equity Brief on India (October 2026)?
o: The extreme poverty line used is US$2.15/day (2021 PPP)
About 49.6 crore people were lifted out of extreme poverty
At US$4.20/day (2021 PPP), poverty fell from 57.7% to 16.1%
The extreme poverty line used is US$3.00/day (2021 PPP)
x: The extreme poverty line is US$3.00/day (2021 PPP), not US$2.15.

s: What is India's rank in the Henley Passport Index 2026?
x: India improved from 85th to 84th in the Henley index; 88th is its rank in the WJP index and 100th in the GHI.

s: What weight does child stunting carry in the Global Hunger Index?
x: Undernourishment and under-5 mortality carry 1/3 each; stunting and wasting 1/6 each.

s: According to the CEA report for August 2026, which rank did Telangana reach for the first time among States in peak power demand?
x: Telangana rose from 8th to 5th for the first time, with 17,263 MW.

s: Which of the following neighbours of India ranked below India in the Global Hunger Index 2026?
x: Pakistan was 106th, below India (100th); China, Nepal, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka ranked above India.

s: Which country topped the WJP Rule of Law Index 2026?
x: Denmark (0.90) was 1st, Norway 2nd and Finland 3rd; India was 88th of 143.

s: According to the ASI Annual Report 2025-26, which monument was the second most visited by domestic tourists, after the Taj Mahal?
x: Konark Sun Temple (34.2 lakh) was second after the Taj Mahal; Golconda Fort was 7th.

s: Which country topped the Quality of Care Perception Index of the Ipsos Health Service Report 2026, in which India was 3rd?
x: Top five were Malaysia, Singapore, India, Vietnam and Australia among 32 countries.

s: Which organisations prepare the Global Hunger Index?
x: The GHI 2026 was prepared by Welthungerhilfe, IFHV (Ruhr University Bochum) and Helvetas; India was 100th of 122.

s: In which year was the Archaeological Survey of India established?
x: The ASI was set up in 1861; it is under the Ministry of Culture.

s: In which year was the World Justice Project, which publishes the Rule of Law Index, established?
x: The WJP was founded in 2006 and is based in Washington DC.

s: What share of the AYUSH services workforce was made up of women, as per the Ayush Services Sector Report 2026?
x: The RIS-prepared report found women were 43% of the workforce, and over 60% in spas and wellness resorts.
